newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Qatar issues Q1 '97 oil products sell tender.
newsitem.headline: Qatar issues Q1 '97 oil products sell tender.

text.p: State-owned Qatar General Petroleum Corp (QGPC) has issued a tender to sell a total of 275,000 tonnes of refined oil products for loading in the first quarter of 1997, industry sources said on Monday.
The volume offered is 50,000 tonnes less than the 325,000 tonnes awarded in the fourth quarter.

The tender offers to sell three 20,000-tonne cargoes of 90-octane unleaded gasoline, three 25,000-tonne cargoes of 0.5 percent sulphur gas oil, three 20,000-tonne cargoes of jet fuel and two 40,000-tonne cargoes of fuel oil.
The tender closes December 7 and offers are valid until December 9, traders said.

In its last tender to sell cargoes for loading in the fourth quarter, QGPC awarded five gas oil cargoes at between a 90-92 cents premium, three jet fuel cargoes at a $1.40-1.60 premium, two fuel oil cargoes at a $12.50 premium and three gasoline cargoes at between a $2.00-2.40 premium, traders said.
All cargoes were awarded at premiums to spot MidEast quotes on a free-on-board basis.
